heading: About Me
tagline: Notes on code, projects, and whatever else I'm into this month.
body:
Hi, I'm Charlie Cunningham. I'm a developer who likes building things end to end, from a scrappy idea to something real people can use — usually favoring a boring, well-understood stack over the trendiest option.

This site is where I write up projects, experiments, and things I've learned along the way: what shipped, what broke, and what I'd do differently next time. It's a hand-built static site with no database and no tracking scripts I didn't put there myself.

Thanks for stopping by — feel free to reach out using the links below.
